title: Stela configuration
description: stela.config.json (design §8.2). Paths are relative to the file's directory. The CLI also checks what a schema can't: unique names, generated files, and macro prefixes; and that each library's targets are a subset of the global list.

targets.description: Every target the model covers, in model order. Required by `stela extract`.

binaries.description: The binaries that implement libraries and embed their manifest (`stela gen embed`, design §12).

exports.description: all (default): the binary exports every function of its libraries. none: it exports none of them and implements them only through function tables.

otherExports.description: Whether the binary may export names outside its libraries (default true). `stela verify` rejects any other export when false.

macroConstants.description: Integer macros allowed by the macro_constants rule.

baselines.description: Library name → its baseline stela.model/1, written by `stela baseline` and compared by `stela diff`.

experimental.description: Headers whose declarations are experimental: `stela diff` reports their breaks as notes.

includeDirs.description: Include directories, as a consumer sets them; generated tests include each entry header relative to the first one that holds it.

owns.description: Files or directories whose declarations belong to the library. Default: the entry headers.

defines.description: NAME or NAME=VALUE, defined before the entry headers when extracting and in generated tests.

targets.description: The library's targets when it doesn't ship on every global target.

stelaHeader.description: The generated <lib>_stela.h, or false for an extension library that uses another library's. Default: <macroPrefix lowercased>_stela.h next to the first header.
